A BlitzLLVM extension: sets how far [AutoHDR](AutoHDR) mode 2 lifts highlights. With 0 nothing is lifted (it looks like mode 1), with 1 pure white reaches the peak of the display ([AutoHDRPeak](AutoHDRPeak)). The lift grows with the square of the brightness of a color, so the shadows and mid tones stay where SDR has them. The default is 0.5. Does nothing in the other modes. The environment variable `BLITZLLVM_AUTOHDR_EXPAND` sets it at start.
@param strength  From 0 to 1.
